pages.label: End of Chapter 9

scripts.desc: Heishin keeps the crown.

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: The crown drinks. Crawl to Relic Rhea or the Crown Cellar, then return.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: He outplayed me. Cards, then rematch.

scripts.desc: Heishin after defeat.

pages.speaker: heishin
pages.text: Pegasus knew. He always knew. Go upstairs and ask him why.

scripts.desc: Relic Rhea, Relic Alcove.

pages.speaker: relic_rhea
pages.text: Crowns crack. Cards last. Buy what the hall drops.

scripts.desc: Hall camp game-over warning.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: A tarp by the entrance pillars. Staff keep one lantern for the starless.
pages.label: Hall Camp

pages.speaker: staff
pages.text: Pretty hall. Deadly rules. Lose your last star and your journey ends for good.

scripts.desc: Dream stairs before Heishin falls.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Stairs up to a bright door. The crown's hum still blocks the step.
pages.label: Dream Stairs

scripts.desc: Dream stairs after Heishin: chapter 10 next.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: The crown is quiet. Upstairs: Pegasus, a wish, and the end of the show.
pages.label: Dream Stairs

scripts.desc: Chapter 9 -> 10: stairs into the Dream Room.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Cards pinned like butterflies. A window to the sea. Pegasus smiles.
pages.label: Dream Room

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: Ten stars. One show left.

scripts.desc: Return to the Dream Room.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: The sea window still burns orange. The table waits.
pages.label: Dream Room

scripts.desc: Back down to the Castle Hall.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Illusion halls below. The crown pedestal is quiet.
pages.label: Hall Stairs

scripts.desc: Chapter 10 opens: Pegasus, Shadi cameo, the wish table.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: A dueling table. Three wish orbs. Shadi stands by a pillar and nods once.
pages.label: Dream Room

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: You kept your stars. He is waiting. I am only the messenger - still.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Darling! Ten stars, a cracked crown, and a rookie who ruins my chamberlain's hobby.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: You knew about Heishin.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: I wanted to see if anyone would stop him. You did. Now - a real duel. A wish if you win.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Duel Pegasus at the dream table.
pages.label: Objective

scripts.desc: Shadi's last cameo line in the Dream Room.

pages.speaker: shadi
pages.text: I deliver ends. Yours is a kind one, if you win.

scripts.desc: Pegasus final duel: hidden-hand flavor, holds 2.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: I play with a hidden hand, darling. Two stars on the table. Wager what your nerve allows.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: For everyone he hurt. For the wish.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Then smile for the window. Shall the dream speak?

scripts.desc: Pegasus loses: wish choice opens.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Marvelous! The eye saw it, and still lost. Choose, hero: a Dream Card, everyone's stars back, or a Festival for all.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: A festival. Everyone goes home happy - and parties first.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Canon, darling. A Festival it is. Meet me in your little village.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Card Dark Magician. The Festival wish is set.
pages.label: You got

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Pegasus's Dream yields. The Festival epilogue waits in the village.
pages.label: End of Chapter 10

scripts.desc: Pegasus keeps the table.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Almost a finale. Relic Rhea downstairs, or try again when your deck smiles.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: He read my hand. Rematch.

scripts.desc: Pegasus after the win, before epilogue warp.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Go home. I already sent the invitations. Fashionably late is still late.

scripts.desc: Wish pedestal reminder after Pegasus.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Festival burns brightest. The village plaza is calling.
pages.label: Wish Orbs

scripts.desc: Festival epilogue on the village plaza.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Your home plaza is strung with star lanterns. Every rival you met waves from a stall.
pages.label: Festival

pages.speaker: simon
pages.text: You still owe me a card. Do not think a festival clears the debt.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: I will duel you for it. After cake.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: On the plaza bench, the green shimmer finally sits still. You notice him.
pages.label: Bench

pages.speaker: mago_hidden
pages.text: Took you long enough.

pages.speaker: atos
pages.text: MAGO.DEV. You were in every chapter.

pages.speaker: mago_hidden
pages.text: And now you see me. Good game.

pages.speaker: pegasus
pages.text: Darlings! Drink, duel, dance! My Kingdom loved its rookies today.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: Duelist Kingdom complete. The festival lasts as long as you walk the plaza.
pages.label: The End

scripts.desc: Dream Room camp warning.

pages.speaker: narrator
pages.text: A small tarp by the wish orbs. Even finales have rules.
pages.label: Dream Camp

pages.speaker: staff
pages.text: Pretty room. Deadly rules. Lose your last star and your journey ends for good.
